verification: Each live CLI batch verifies project, program path, language and image base. Full specified byte ranges compare equal to installed PE; this is source evidence, not game validation.

annotation_proposals.proposed_comment: Group-order/category0-then1 upload: attach(scene,false), category1 signed-material/depth sort, geometry0 stream1 lock(count,0,0), generator v+8 writes and declaration+CC advances, unlock, section0+1C count, retained entry initialize, borrowed pointer queue append. Checked typed success domain; exact insertion<=32, larger finite distinct keys only. See docs/INSTANCE_GROUP_UPLOAD.md and reports/instance_group_upload_audit.json.
ECX section, stack count, RET4; unconditional DWORD store to+1C. Typed GeneratedInstanceSection instance_count setter, no native layout ABI claim. See docs/INSTANCE_GROUP_UPLOAD.md.

ECX entry,8 stack words,RET20h. Stores leading/section/geometry/model/camera/visibility/flags, preserves+20/+24 key. Positive depth override direct; otherwise camera view then v+48 actual world sphere center,004142e0 transform Z plussection+34. Callback and x87 value projection, no native object ownership ABI. See docs/INSTANCE_GROUP_UPLOAD.md.

ECX batch,stack borrowed entry,RET4. Grow queue pointer capacity max256 or double when full via00b51b50, then store pointer/increment count; no retain or clone. Full allocator tail verified despite no-return free annotation. New owning pointer-array interface with borrowed entries. See docs/INSTANCE_GROUP_UPLOAD.md.

limits: New host types do not reproduce native object layouts or intrusive lifetimes.
Callbacks must bind actual borrowed model scene attachment, world sphere and generator operations; no default callbacks exist.
Generated geometry/material clone/scene producer contracts remain owned by their separate reconstruction packets.
Category1 supports finite depths; <=32 preserves native stable insertion permutation; larger inputs require comparator-distinct keys. Native large-list partition/heapsort tie order is unported.
Source count must equal active instance count; declarations, lists and bound identities must remain stable during callbacks.
Native malformed-container, overflow and ignored failure behavior are replaced by explicit host errors.
Queue owns pointer storage only; caller-owned entries/models/cameras/geometry must outlive consumption.
Previous category effects persist after failure; successful stream locks are unlocked during failure unwinding.
x87 kernel operation/spill order is retained; no surrounding native FP exception or NaN payload claim.
